name: deepseek-worker
description: Let Claude hand off well-specified coding and web research to DeepSeek as a cheap worker, with token and balance usage in the status line.

api_key.title: DeepSeek API key
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable or ~/.config/deepseek/api_key.

allow_outside_workdir.title: Allow files outside the working folder
allow_outside_workdir.description: Off by default: `files` and `output_path` may only read and write inside the session's working folder.
